command:
set -euo pipefail
BASE=a1a37a153ece90367f7850b0d4334f74b29c9cbf
git fetch origin mvp/environment-controller agent-control
git reset --hard origin/mvp/environment-controller
git clean -fd
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE"
git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/20260902-stage27c-sd-reference-align-v1.py | python3
.venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --files src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.h src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp || true
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.h src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp
git diff --check
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_stage27c_soak.py -q
cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests
cmake --build build/host-tests --target stage27_telemetry_tests --parallel
ctest --test-dir build/host-tests -R '^stage27_telemetry_tests$' --output-on-failure
grep -q 'kSdSpiHost = SPI3_HOST' src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp
grep -q 'kPowerOnDelayMs = 100U' src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp
! grep -q 'ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE' src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp
grep -q 'releaseSpiBus();' src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp
git add src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.h src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp
git commit -m 'Align Stage27C SD transport with CrowPanel reference'
NEW_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "[AGENT_PROGRESS] sd_reference_align_sha=$NEW_SHA"
bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh clean
GROWBOX_FIRMWARE_GIT_SHA="$NEW_SHA" bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh build
test -f build/idf-stage27c-crowpanel/growbox_ml_controller.bin
grep -aFq "$NEW_SHA" build/idf-stage27c-crowpanel/growbox_ml_controller.bin
git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
test -z "$(git status --short)"
PORT_S3="$(.venv/bin/python -c 'from tools.stage27c_soak import detect_ch340_port; print(detect_ch340_port())')"
source scripts/source_idf.sh
PROBE="$(python -m esptool --port "$PORT_S3" chip_id 2>&1)"
echo "$PROBE"
grep -q 'ESP32-S3' <<<"$PROBE"
PORT="$PORT_S3" GROWBOX_FIRMWARE_GIT_SHA="$NEW_SHA" bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh flash
sleep 3
PORT_POST="$(.venv/bin/python -c 'from tools.stage27c_soak import detect_ch340_port; print(detect_ch340_port())')"
POST_PROBE="$(python -m esptool --port "$PORT_POST" chip_id 2>&1)"
echo "$POST_PROBE"
grep -q 'ESP32-S3' <<<"$POST_PROBE"
OUT=build/stage27c-sd-reference-align-smoke-${NEW_SHA:0:7}
rm -rf "$OUT"
.venv/bin/python tools/stage27c_soak.py --port "$PORT_POST" --output-dir "$OUT" --duration 300 --progress-seconds 60 --expected-sha "$NEW_SHA" --max-scd-age-ms 15000 --max-tp-age-ms 60000 --max-xiaomi-age-ms 30000 --require-sd --strict
echo '[AGENT_PROGRESS] sd_reference_align_smoke_summary'
cat "$OUT/summary.json"
test -z "$(git status --short)"
echo "PUBLISHED_SHA=$NEW_SHA"
